verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਥਿ ਸਕਥ ਹਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh hath sakath han saadhasa(n)gat gur kaar kamaavai|

en.bdb: Worthy are the hands of the Sikh who in the holy congregation do the Guru's work.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਹਣਾ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣਾਮਤੁ ਪਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: paanee pakhaa peehanaa pair dhoi charanaamat paavai|

en.bdb: Who draw water, fan the sangat, grind the flour, wash the feet of Guru and drink the water therefrom;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਿਖਿ ਪੋਥੀਆ ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਰਬਾਬ ਵਜਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurbaanee likh potheeaa taal miradha(n)g rabaab vajaavai|

en.bdb: Who copy the Guru's hymns and play the cymbals, the mirdang, a small drum, and the rabaab in the company of holy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਡੰਡਉਤ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: namasakaar dda(n)ddaut kar gurbhaiee gal mil gal laavai|

en.bdb: Worthy are the hands who bow, help in prostrating and embrace a brother Sikh;

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਦੀ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇ ਕੈ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: kirat virat kar dharam dhee hathahu dhe kai bhalaa manaavai|

en.bdb: Who earn a livelihood honestly and munificently confer favour on others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: paaras paras aparas hoi par tan par dhan hath na laavai|

en.bdb: Worthy of praise are the hands of such a Sikh who by coming in touch with Guru becomes indifferent to worldly materials and lays not his eyes on another's wife or property;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪੂਜ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵੈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh gursikh pooj kai bhai bhagat bhai bhaanaa bhaavai|

en.bdb: Who loves another Sikh and embraces the love, devotion, and fear of God;
He effaces his ego and does not assert himself.
